name: paperless-ngx
description: Search, read, file and upload documents in a paperless-ngx archive.

url.title: Paperless URL
url.description: Base URL of your paperless-ngx install, e.g. https://paperless.example.com. A trailing /api is stripped, so either form works.

token.title: API token
token.description: Paperless web UI -> user menu -> My Profile -> the circular arrow next to API Token.

read_only.title: Read-only mode
read_only.description: Refuse every tool that would modify the archive. Downloads still write files, inside the download directory below.

download_dir.title: Download directory
download_dir.description: The only directory downloads may be written into. Leave empty for a private directory under your system temp folder.

upload_dirs.title: Upload directories
upload_dirs.description: Comma-separated directories uploads may read from, e.g. ~/Documents/scans. Leave empty to allow only the download directory.
